_comment: Hotspots for the film viewer's 'Show me the finding'. x/y/r are percentages of the image box, so they hold at any zoom. Coordinates were read off a 10% grid overlay of each image (tools_grid_sheet.py), not estimated - a ring beside the pathology teaches the wrong thing. Only findings that are unambiguously locatable in the image are annotated.

xr_foreign_body.label: Coin, en face — oesophagus, not trachea

us_aaa.label: Dilated aortic lumen — measure outer wall to outer wall

us_ivc.label: IVC — gauge collapse 2 cm from the cava-atrial junction

ct_subdural.label: Midline pushed away from the collection

xr_shoulder_dislocation.label: Humeral head below and medial to the glenoid

ct_aaa.label: Aneurysmal aorta — measure outer wall to outer wall

ct_free_air.label: Free gas collects anteriorly — look non-dependent

ct_cspine.label: Low cervical spine — follow the posterior vertebral line

mri_cauda_equina.label: Lower lumbar discs — follow the posterior margin

mri_epidural_abscess.label: Epidural space — look for a collection on the cord

xr_hip_dislocation.label: Prosthetic head, out of the acetabular cup

xr_supracondylar.label: Supracondylar humerus — check the anterior humeral line and fat pads

ct_soft_tissue_gas.label: Subcutaneous fat — gas tracking in the tissue planes

us_poor_ef.label: M-mode — how far do the walls actually move?

derm_zoster.label: Grouped vesicles in one dermatome — does it stop at the midline?
